info.title: API.SH: Cadremploi
info.description: The Cadremploi API from API.SH: public Cadremploi data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A company's page on Cadremploi.fr: name, tagline, description, website, logo, employees, year founded, average age, share of women, address, number of open jobs, the `company_id` and `jobs_url` for its jobs (use `company_id` in /cadremploi/v1/search), social links and video ids. get.description:
One job ad on Cadremploi.fr: title, full description and candidate profile, experience level, location (city, postal code, department, region, coordinates), contract and duration, salary range (unless hidden), job functions and sectors with codes, occupation, the company (description, logo, badges, page link) and its company page data (website, employees, women share, average age, address, images), how to apply (channel, reference, application e-mail when the ad shows one), badges, publication and expiry dates, similar jobs and more jobs from the company. `latest=true` with search parameters returns the first matching ad. Removed ads answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cadremploi-job

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Job id from search (digits) or a cadremploi.fr/emploi/detail_offre?offreId=... link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the first ad of the search given by the other parameters (same parameters as /cadremploi/v1/search).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: With `latest=true`: search text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: At least 2 characters, e.g. `lyon`, `bordeaux`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Jobs on Cadremploi.fr, the French job board for managers and professionals, with every filter of the site: keywords, contract type, job function, sector, region, department, city with radius, company, recruiter type (company or recruitment agency), minimum yearly salary and section (e.g. young graduates). Each job: `id`, `title`, `url`, `company` (type, logo, badges), `location`, `contract`, `salary` as shown, `posted_text`, `snippet`, `apply_type` (form or redirect), `source`, `badges`, `match` (`exact`, or `expanded`/`around_city`/`nearby` when the site widens the search) and `raw`. `total` and its parts (`total_exact`, `total_expanded`…), `applied_filters`, and `refine` (the site's function, sector, region, department, city, company and contract links for this search). 30 jobs per page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cadremploi-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search, e.g. `python`, `contrôleur de gestion`.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Keywords as the site's older `motscles` search.

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: Contract type: `cdi`, `cdd`, `interim`, `freelance`, `stage`, `alternance`; several comma-separated (or the site's numeric `tyc` codes).

parameters.name: function
parameters.description: Job function codes (the `fct` codes in the site's links, e.g. `10200` finance, `2` production/IT); several comma-separated.

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Sector codes (from /cadremploi/v1/sectors, e.g. `40000` IT/telecom); several comma-separated.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region ISO codes as the site uses them, e.g. `FR-J` (Ile-de-France), `FR-V` (Rhône-Alpes); several comma-separated.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Department numbers, e.g. `75`, `92`, `69`; several comma-separated.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City slugs as the site uses them, e.g. `paris-75`, `lyon-69` (`search_city` in /cadremploi/v1/locations).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Kilometres around `city` (default 20).

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Company ids (`company_id` from /cadremploi/v1/company); several comma-separated.

parameters.name: company_type
parameters.description: Recruiter type: a company hiring for itself or a recruitment agency.

parameters.name: salary_min
parameters.description: Minimum yearly salary in thousands of euros, e.g. `45`.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Site section, e.g. `_jeunes_diplomes` (young graduates).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Cadremploi.fr's sector list with codes and parent sectors; the codes go into the search's `sector` filter.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cadremploi-sectors

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
